volatility.input: 30 trailing decision-available daily close-to-close log returns

matching.order: ascending instrument/fold/strategy/horizon/candidate decision time; seeded comparator hash within each pool
matching.reuse: without replacement within instrument/fold/side/horizon/bucket until exhausted; then lowest reuse count, seeded hash tie-break
matching.exhaustion: pool below 20 is unmatched and never widened

links: overlapping candidate or comparator forward windows
dependence.gate: below 20 components remains descriptive only; the gate is never relaxed

warning: This report contains pool and dependency structure only. No candidate/comparator returns, intervals, or qualification outcome were calculated.
